title: Life design
learning_outcomes: Explain life domains in the context of life design.
Compare and distinguish alternative futures in the context of life design.
Apply reversible experiments in the context of life design.
Evaluate and justify decisions about trade-offs in the context of life design.

lessons.title: Life domains
lessons.outcome: Explain life domains in the context of life design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving life domains; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to three life plans.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain life domains from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of life domains; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Alternative futures
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish alternative futures in the context of life design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving alternative futures; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to three life plans.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain alternative futures from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of alternative futures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reversible experiments
lessons.outcome: Apply reversible experiments in the context of life design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reversible experiments; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to three life plans.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reversible experiments from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reversible experiments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Trade-offs
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about trade-offs in the context of life design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving trade-offs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to three life plans.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain trade-offs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of life domains; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of alternative futures; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reversible experiments; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
